items.title: Repair the trusted-worktree registration check
items.description: A regression landed in the project trusted-paths check. Directories that hand-write a `.git` pointer at a listed checkout, or that borrow an existing worktree's admin directory, are being treated as trusted linked worktrees again, and a trusted-paths file with a wrong or missing version field is accepted. Restore the check so only a genuine git-registered linked worktree is trusted and the trusted-paths file is validated on its version field.
acceptance_criteria: only a genuine linked worktree of a listed checkout is trusted
an arbitrary gitdir-pointer directory and a borrowed admin directory are refused
a trusted-paths list whose version is missing or not exactly 1 yields no trusted paths
